observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same orange gas cylinder (possibly two of a pair) on a metal shelf in what looks like a shop or roadside stall.
Cylinder body reads 'Butano 12,5 kg', 'UN 1965', and a 'REPSOL' style logo plate near the base of the printed text.
Numbers '901 350 150' and '901 12 12 12' are printed on the body (appear to be a helpline/contact number, not a serial plate).
Surface shows scuffs, scratches, faded paint, and surface rust spots, especially near the base.
A wire-mesh protective sleeve around the lower body is visibly frayed/torn in places.
Valve/collar at top has an orange protective cap over the regulator connection; no visible pressure gauge.
No visible manufacture or re-test/inspection date stamp on the collar or shoulder in either photo.
Second, partially visible cylinder (red/orange) stands beside the main one in both shots, not the subject of the listing.
Background shows an informal roadside/shop setting, consistent with Lagos street market.

claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo gas Cylinder (implies genuine foreign-used import, not locally refurbished)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, customs marking, or distinguishing feature visible in either photo to confirm import origin or history.

risks.risk: Valve/regulator seal condition unknown — could leak or fail pressure test.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve being opened/closed, or a soap-bubble leak test clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve/seal not verified, assume needs replacement

risks.risk: No visible manufacture or re-certification/test date stamp, which determines legal usability age in many markets.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the collar/shoulder stamp showing test date.
risks.if_unproven: priced as uncertified/unknown test date, worst case near or past expiry

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or contamination not visible from outside, especially given exterior rust spots.
risks.proof: Photo of interior via valve removed, or a recent hydrostatic test certificate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume corrosion risk present

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty, partially filled, or sold without gas.
risks.proof: Weighing video or receipt from a filling station.
risks.if_unproven: priced as empty, cylinder only, no gas included

risks.risk: Torn wire-mesh guard suggests prior damage or wear history not explained by seller.
risks.proof: Wider photo showing full extent of mesh damage and any dents beneath it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural concern, condition rated below average

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the collar/shoulder stamp showing manufacture and last test date.
Video of the valve opening and a basic leak test (soap bubbles) under pressure.
Photo showing the full cylinder weight on a scale (tare weight is usually stamped, compare to actual).
Any receipt or paperwork from the point of import or last refill/test.
response.reason: The cylinder type and brand are clearly readable (Repsol Butano 12.5kg) and it can be priced as a used, uncertified cylinder with unverified valve condition and unknown fill state, which sets its worst-case value; no missing shot blocks a baseline price, though the listed proofs could raise it.
